name: kanban-agent
description: Give your Claude agents a shared board to work from. Planner groups related tasks into functional units, implementers build each group in an isolated git worktree, reviewer checks the combined diff, QA runs it and confirms it works. Everyone coordinates through one SQLite database — no manual handoffs.

hooks.command: sqlite3 -column -header .kanban/kanban.db "SELECT changed_at, table_name, record_id, field, old_value, new_value FROM change_log ORDER BY changed_at DESC LIMIT 5;"
